CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.expense_sync_resolution()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_ticket_id uuid; v_org_id uuid; v_res_id uuid;
BEGIN
  v_res_id := COALESCE(NEW.ticket_resolution_id, OLD.ticket_resolution_id);
  IF v_res_id IS NULL THEN RETURN COALESCE(NEW, OLD); END IF;

  SELECT ticket_id, organization_id INTO v_ticket_id, v_org_id
    FROM public.ticket_resolutions WHERE id = v_res_id;
  IF v_ticket_id IS NULL THEN RETURN COALESCE(NEW, OLD); END IF;

  IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
    UPDATE public.ticket_resolutions SET
      total_cost=0, actual_total_cost=0, total_parts_cost=0, total_labour_cost=0,
      payment_date=NULL, bank_account_id=NULL, payment_reference_no=NULL,
      proof_of_payment_url=NULL, proof_of_purchase_url=NULL,
      vendor_id=NULL,
      actual_items_used='[]'::jsonb, items_used='[]'::jsonb,
      updated_at=now()
    WHERE id = v_res_id;
    INSERT INTO public.ticket_logs(ticket_id, organization_id, action, notes)
    VALUES (v_ticket_id, v_org_id, 'Expense deleted',
      'Linked expense (#' || substr(OLD.id::text, 1, 8) ||
      ') removed; resolution cost & payment cleared.');

  ELSIF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' THEN
    IF NEW.amount IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.amount
       OR NEW.expense_date IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.expense_date
       OR NEW.vendor_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.vendor_id
       OR NEW.receipt_url IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.receipt_url
    THEN
      UPDATE public.ticket_resolutions SET
        total_cost            = NEW.amount,
        actual_total_cost     = NEW.amount,
        payment_date          = NEW.expense_date,
        vendor_id             = COALESCE(NEW.vendor_id, vendor_id),
        proof_of_purchase_url = COALESCE(NEW.receipt_url, proof_of_purchase_url),
        updated_at            = now()
      WHERE id = v_res_id;
      INSERT INTO public.ticket_logs(ticket_id, organization_id, action, notes)
      VALUES (v_ticket_id, v_org_id, 'Expense updated',
        'Linked expense updated; resolution synced (amount=₹' ||
        COALESCE(NEW.amount::text,'0') || ', date=' ||
        COALESCE(NEW.expense_date::text,'—') || ').');
    END IF;
  END IF;
  RETURN COALESCE(NEW, OLD);
END $function$
